name: Yorkshire Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Add milk gradually to form a smooth paste
Add eggs beaten until very light
Cover bottom of hot pan with some of beef fat tried out from roast
Pour mixture in pan one-half inch deep
Bake twenty minutes in hot oven
Baste after well risen, with some of the fat from pan in which meat is roasting
Bake, if preferred, in greased, hissing hot iron gem pans

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix salt and flour
2. Add milk gradually to form a smooth paste
3. Add eggs beaten until very light
4. Cover bottom of hot pan with some of beef fat tried out from roast
5. Pour mixture in pan one-half inch deep
6. Bake twenty minutes in hot oven
7. Baste after well risen, with some of the fat from pan in which meat is roasting
8. Cut in squares for serving
9. Bake, if preferred, in greased, hissing hot iron gem pans
